safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated does not explicitly state no cellulitis.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Failing to document that there was no evidence of cellulitis may leave ambiguity about whether a secondary bacterial skin infection was considered/excluded, which can influence decisions around antibiotics and follow-up. In this context (very acute insect sting with localized erythema), the immediate risk is low but could lead to unnecessary treatment or extra monitoring.
